_comment: Declared cross-asset subtleties update-cla must surface at sync time.
Read from the SOURCE repo by discover.py, so a source that learns a new
requirement teaches every consumer on the next sync without any consumer
editing anything. Both categories below have SILENT failure modes, which
is why they are data checked by a script rather than prose in SKILL.md.
Paths are repo-relative, exactly as they appear in divergences.json.

companion_overlays.note: This hook holds no repo facts (fact/procedure split): it reads the component/i18n path patterns and the smoke-test location from the overlay and NO-OPS SILENTLY when the overlay is absent. A repo that had the check working before this asset was parameterized loses it on sync with no warning. Create the overlay to restore it; the previous hardcoded values were component_path_substring: src/components/, component_ext: .tsx, i18n_path_substring: src/i18n/, i18n_ext: .json, smoke_test_relpath: test-app.mjs. A *.local.md leaf is never synced or overwritten.

lockstep_groups.name: hooks shared git helpers
lockstep_groups.note: block-worktree-path-escape.py and guard-worktree-isolation.py import run_git/clone_paths from _dispatch_lib.py. Applying an importer without the updated _dispatch_lib is an ImportError at hook load; the dispatcher isolates and reports it, so it is audible rather than silent, but the guard does not run for that session.

lockstep_groups.name: hooks shared git-command matchers
lockstep_groups.note: These six import GIT_GLOBAL_OPTS / strip_quoted_spans (and warn-branch-base also default_base_branch) from _dispatch_lib.py. Same failure mode as above: an importer applied without a compatible _dispatch_lib fails to load.
